description: wb-ops: 工具输出压缩（Grep/Glob/WebFetch）+ 记忆守卫（SessionStart 检查用户记忆超限并提醒精简）+ 上下文守卫 v2（UserPromptSubmit：学习各模型真实自动压缩点、双档提醒、压缩后水位检查）+ 压缩指令注入（PreCompact：为压缩摘要注入保留清单）

hooks.command: R="${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$R/hooks/ctx-guard.mjs"; for N in "$(command -v node)" "$HOME/.workbuddy/binaries/node/versions/"*/node.exe "/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe"; do [ -n "$N" ] && [ -x "$N" ] && "$N" "$S" && break; done; exit 0

R="${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$R/hooks/memory-guard.mjs"; for N in "$(command -v node)" "$HOME/.workbuddy/binaries/node/versions/"*/node.exe "/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe"; do [ -n "$N" ] && [ -x "$N" ] && "$N" "$S" && break; done; exit 0

R="${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$R/bin/TRACE-ON" ] && export WB_OPS_TRACE=1; E="$R/bin/wb-ops-trim.exe"; if [ -x "$E" ]; then "$E"; else for PY in "$(command -v python)" "$(command -v python3)" "$HOME/.workbuddy/binaries/python/versions/"*/python.exe /c/Python3*/python.exe; do [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -x "$PY" ] && "$PY" "$R/hooks/trim.py" && break; done; fi; exit 0

R="${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; S="$R/hooks/precompact.mjs"; for N in "$(command -v node)" "$HOME/.workbuddy/binaries/node/versions/"*/node.exe "/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe"; do [ -n "$N" ] && [ -x "$N" ] && "$N" "$S" && break; done; exit 0
